problem_statement: Adrinlol/landy-react-template (rebranded here as 'Launch Discovery Studio', a SaaS launch-consultancy marketing landing) is a Create-React-App + TypeScript site built from JSON content with Ant Design layout, styled-components, i18next, react-awesome-reveal, lazy-loaded sections (ContentBlock/MiddleBlock/ContactForm), a smooth-scroll header and a validated discovery contact form. The site presents its launch engagement tiers in a 'Launch plans' section (src/components/PlanBoard) with three plan cards (Launch Audit / Implementation Sprint / Conversion Continuity), but the prices are fixed to a single monthly figure and there is no way to see the annual price. Enhance the site's OWN launch-plan feature with a Monthly / Annual billing control and carry it consistently across the site, preserving the Landy visual system (blue/purple #18216d/#2e186a text, tinted plan cards, Motiva Sans type scale, Ant Design grid, section rhythm): (1) ADD a billing switch to the plans section — a '.plan-board__billing' bar with a 'Billing' label, a Monthly/Annual toggle and a '.plan-board__readout' line — and give each plan card a monthly AND an annual price. Make the plan grid and the billing bar stay within the viewport on a 390px phone and an 834px tablet with no horizontal document overflow; do not merely clip them with overflow-x:hidden — the document itself must not exceed the viewport width. (2) Render the SAME launch-plan board on the home 'Launch plans' section, a dedicated /plans route AND a compact contact-side plans strip (plan-board--home / --plans / --contact) so the plan board is a site-wide fixture, not a home-only afterthought. (3) Keep the plan grid in the Landy palette (tinted plan cards, the dark 'popular' card) and make it visually faithful to the reference in the Annual state — the plan cards must not overlap, clip or wash out into illegible text when a period is selected. (4) Wire the billing toggle end to end: clicking 'Annual' must swap every plan card's price to its annual figure (e.g. Implementation Sprint '$4,200/mo' -> '$40,320/yr'), update the plan note to 'billed annually · 2 months free', and set the '.plan-board__readout' to 'Billing: Annual · 2 months free' (and back on 'Monthly'); the post-click terminal state must reflect the selected period, not stay frozen on Monthly. Keep the hero, section labels (Readiness/Architecture/Handoff), the discovery contact form, the mobile drawer, the footer, the language icons, the logo and the local SVG illustrations intact, keep the react-scripts/TypeScript build, and keep the browser console clean.
required_content: The 'Launch plans' section gains a '.plan-board__billing' control (a 'Billing' label, a Monthly/Annual toggle and a '.plan-board__readout' line) and the plan grid + billing bar stay within the viewport on a 390px phone and 834px tablet with no horizontal document overflow beyond 24px.

The same launch-plan board appears consistently on the home 'Launch plans' section, the /plans route AND the contact-side plans strip (plan-board--home / --plans / --contact) — one shared board in all three places, not only on the home page.

The plan grid keeps the Landy look (tinted plan cards, the dark 'popular' card, blue/purple text) and is visually faithful to the reference in the Annual state — the cards do not overlap, clip or wash out into illegible text.

The billing toggle is wired end to end: clicking Annual swaps every plan price to its annual figure (Implementation Sprint '$4,200/mo' -> '$40,320/yr'), updates the note to 'billed annually · 2 months free' and sets the readout to 'Billing: Annual · 2 months free'; the post-click terminal state reflects the selected period, not the default Monthly.
The desktop (1440px) and tablet (834px) layouts stay within their viewports and the plan cards wrap/stack cleanly on 390px mobile.

The hero headline 'Launch-ready landing systems for SaaS teams', the section labels Readiness/Architecture/Handoff, the discovery contact form fields, the footer, the language icons, the logo, the mobile drawer and the local SVG illustrations remain present and unchanged, and the react-scripts build stays clean (no console errors).
design_constraints: Build the plan grid and the '.plan-board__billing' bar so they wrap/shrink within a 390px phone and 834px tablet; do not force a fixed-width nowrap row or fake the fix with overflow-x:hidden.
Render the SAME launch-plan board on the home section, the /plans route AND the contact-side strip so it is consistent site-wide; do not add it to only one surface.

Preserve the Landy visual language: blue/purple text (#18216d / #2e186a), tinted plan cards, the dark 'popular' card, Motiva Sans type scale, Ant Design grid columns and section spacing; the Annual state must render the plan cards cleanly, not overlapping/clipped/illegible.
Wire the billing toggle end to end (the plan prices, the plan notes and the readout must all reflect the clicked period), not merely a class toggle.
Keep the CRA/TypeScript/Ant Design/styled-components architecture and all local SVG illustrations; do not add a remote font, ad script, CDN media, generated asset or app rewrite.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial verify the Launch Discovery Studio hero, the header wordmark/logo and the local SVG imagery render across viewports with no horizontal overflow.
desktop_plans_default, mobile_plans_default and tablet_plans_default verify the launch-plan grid + billing bar render in the Landy palette and stay within the phone/tablet viewport.
desktop_plans_annual and mobile_plans_annual click the Annual period and verify the plan grid stays clean (no overlap/clip/illegible cards) and the readout + prices update to the annual figures.
plans_page verifies the SAME launch-plan board is present on the /plans route and contact_strip verifies it on the contact-side plans strip (site-wide consistency).

change_completion: The plans section gains a Monthly/Annual billing control (label, toggle, readout) and the plan grid + billing bar render within the viewport on mobile and tablet.
The same launch-plan board appears on the home section, the /plans route and the contact-side strip.
Clicking Annual updates the plan prices and the readout to the annual period.
design_consistency: The billing control and plan grid preserve the Landy palette, tinted plan cards, dark popular card and section rhythm.
The Annual state renders the plan cards cleanly (no overlap, clip or illegible text) and is visually faithful to the reference on the desktop and mobile plans-annual states.
responsive: 390px and 834px plans states have no horizontal overflow beyond 24px.
The plan cards and billing bar wrap or shrink cleanly instead of forcing a fixed-width row.
regression: Hero copy, section labels, discovery contact form fields, footer, language icons, logo, mobile drawer and local SVG illustrations remain reachable and unchanged.
The site still builds with react-scripts and TypeScript and serves with a clean browser console.

scoring_notes: A correct patch adds the shared Monthly/Annual billing control to the template's own launch-plan section, keeps the plan grid + billing bar within 390px/834px viewports, renders the same board on the home section + /plans route + contact-side strip, keeps the Annual state rendering the plan cards cleanly in the Landy palette, and wires the toggle so the prices, notes and readout reflect the clicked period. A patch that leaves the plan grid a fixed-width nowrap row (baseline) overflows on mobile/tablet; a 'smart-wrong' patch (bad) keeps the fixed-width nowrap grid + masks it with overflow-x:hidden (still overflows), renders the board on the home page only (fails cross-page consistency), collapses the Annual plan grid so the cards overlap/clip and the price and feature text wash out into an illegible near-white (fails visual fidelity), and snapshots the readout/prices into a stale React state so clicking Annual moves the active pill but leaves the readout and prices frozen on Monthly (fails the interaction terminal-state check) while its text and console stay clean.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: Landy React CRA marketing landing with a JSON-driven, lazy-loaded section architecture and its own three-tier launch-plan cards; enhancing that native plan feature with a Monthly/Annual billing control gives a genre-native L4 lever (pricing toggle in a real Plans section) with cross-page (home + /plans + contact) consistency, a mobile/tablet overflow discriminator, an annual-state visual-collapse defect and a stale-state interaction defect, while preserving the React/Ant Design/styled-components structure.

author_notes: Repo-grounded CRA (react-scripts) marketing Edit/experience_continuity task hardened to L4 on the Adrinlol/landy-react-template Launch Discovery Studio site. The lever is the site's OWN launch-plan section (src/components/PlanBoard), enhanced with a Monthly/Annual billing control (the styled-components PlanBoard component + styles + planBoardSurfaces whitelist). The reference (a) adds the .plan-board__billing bar + monthly/annual plan prices and wraps the plan grid so it stays within 390px/834px, (b) renders the same board on the home section, the /plans route and the contact-side strip (plan-board--home/--plans/--contact), (c) keeps the Annual state rendering the plan cards cleanly in the Landy palette, and (d) wires the toggle so the prices, notes and readout reflect the clicked period (live React state read). The bad 'smart-wrong' solution keeps a fixed 820px nowrap plan grid + a decorative overflow-x:hidden (still overflows the document -> D6 fail on mobile/tablet), renders the board on the home page ONLY (D2 cross-page fail on /plans + contact), collapses the Annual plan grid with negative margins so the cards shingle/overlap and the third clips off the edge while the price + feature text wash out to a near-white illegible tone (D3 visual_regression fail on the desktop/mobile plans-annual crops via pixelmatch, ssim and block_fidelity), and snapshots the readout + price labels into a stale React state initializer so clicking Annual moves the active pill and triggers the broken layout but leaves the readout and prices frozen on Monthly (click succeeds -> action_history clean, but the terminal readout is stale -> D4 interaction_assertions fail). It fails FOUR distinct gates while all text/completion/regression/console signals pass; the baseline shares the D6 overflow + home-only board + annual grid collapse but re-syncs the readout/prices live so it PASSES D4 (leg-orthogonal strict subset). INFRA identical across the three legs: the launch-plan section markup, the PlanContent.json data, the /plans route in the react-router config, the removal of the old DiscoveryBoard metric strip, and the Landy body{overflow-x:visible} baseline so the mobile/tablet plan-grid overflow is a real, measurable document-width signal rather than a masked one.
